pages.text: Motorcade adds fully customizable, buildable vehicles. You don't craft a finished car in one recipe: you craft its individual parts, then assemble them into a working automobile.

pages.title: The Build Loop
pages.text:
$(li)Craft a $(l:getting_started/auto_mechanic_table)Auto Mechanic Table$()
$(li)Use it to craft a frame, engine and wheels (and optionally an attachment)
$(li)Place a $(l:getting_started/automobile_assembler)Automobile Assembler$()
$(li)Put your parts on it to build the automobile
$(li)Use a $(l:getting_started/crowbar)Crowbar$() any time you want to take it apart and rebuild it differently
